facts.claim: googleads.googleapis.com v23 is a supported Google Ads API version
displayvideo.googleapis.com v4 is a supported Display & Video 360 API version
dfareporting v5 is a supported Campaign Manager 360 API version
graph.facebook.com v25.0 is a supported Meta Graph API version
searchads360.googleapis.com v0 is the current Search Ads 360 Reporting API version
doubleclicksearch v2 is still available for offline conversion upload/modify
api.thetradedesk.com v3 is the current Trade Desk Platform API version
Microsoft Advertising CampaignManagement v13 is a supported API version
Microsoft Advertising Reporting v13 is a supported API version
Microsoft Advertising CustomerManagement v13 is a supported API version
LinkedIn-Version 202608 is inside LinkedIn's supported release window
advertising-api.amazon.com is the current unversioned API base for this platform
api.pinterest.com is the current unversioned API base for this platform
adsapi.snapchat.com is the current unversioned API base for this platform
business-api.tiktok.com is the current unversioned API base for this platform

The Search Ads 360 Reporting API v0 is read-only for campaign entities — there are no campaign/ad-group/ad mutate operations, so the only governed writes are offline conversion upload/modify via the legacy v2 API.
Pinterest's /v5/media endpoint only supports media_type="video"; image creatives must reference URLs directly.
DV360 returns 400 when deleting a line item that has not been archived first, and archiving is itself irreversible — there is no unarchive.
Amazon expires LwA refresh tokens 365 days after issuance for consent granted on/after 2026-07-30, requiring the advertiser to re-authorize.
LinkedIn's versioned Marketing APIs are served from https://api.linkedin.com/rest/; /v2/ is the legacy unversioned path

facts.claim: The per-process default of 10 requests/min stays within the platform's API quota across the fleet's assumed 10 instances. No Amazon Ads rate-limit number is published in any reachable source (the vendor OpenAPI specs declare only 429). Scope is reportedly per endpoint and per LwA app (corroboration only). The 2026-05-15 live run hit 429 on the first call after 12 minutes idle, suggesting the real limit may be lower than 10/min. Recorded 2026-09-24 from a quota sweep that found no primary source (vendor doc hosts blocked); the figures below are CORROBORATION ONLY (search snippets / third-party mirrors) and the default was deliberately NOT raised on them. Re-verify on the vendor page before changing the default.

The per-process default of 5 requests/min stays within the platform's API quota across the fleet's assumed 10 instances. Corroboration only: 60 queries/min per user (raisable to 600) and 50,000/day per project. Our keys are per profile, not per user, so one user with several profiles can exceed the per-user quota. Recorded 2026-09-24 from a quota sweep that found no primary source (vendor doc hosts blocked); the figures below are CORROBORATION ONLY (search snippets / third-party mirrors) and the default was deliberately NOT raised on them. Re-verify on the vendor page before changing the default.
